title: In "Asset Register" screen, there is an action "Generate QR/Barcode Tag" for add
description: In "Asset Register" screen, there is an action "Generate QR/Barcode Tag" for add
originating_prompt:
In "Asset Register" screen, there is an action "Generate QR/Barcode Tag" for added records, when clicking on that action no QR/Barcode is generating, check the feature and generate a QR code Jasper report on click of that action.
[follow-up] When displaying generated QR Jasper report it looks too small to view, can enlarge it an make QR visible clearly.
result_summary:
Same failure despite the nav entry, so my earlier hypothesis was wrong. Let me find how the platform actually resolves an R object by name.I'll check what objects the platform's own registry sees.The registry does see it. Let me re-run the actual validation the verifier uses.Both models are structurally identical — the only difference is the JRXML filename. Let me test whether the object-name lookup depends on that convention.Everything matches the working report except the JRXML filename. Aligning it to the convention.    "MAIN_JRXML": "report.jrxml",
    "JRXML_FILES": ["report.jrxml"],"}Now re-validating and rendering to confirm the report still works under the standard filename.Let me check every registry file that mentions the working report, to find any my report is missing from.The manifest is a stale snapshot from Aug 13 — my report is the only real object missing from it. Let me mirror the working report's entry.    {
      "obj_name": "fam_asset_qr_tag",
      "obj_type": "R",
      "title": "Asset QR Code Tag",
      "description": "Printable QR code label for a single asset"
    },
    {
      "obj_name": "fam_verification_report",
      "obj_type": "R",
      "title": "Verification Report",
      "description": "Physical verification confirmation document"
    },"}Now let me confirm the platform resolves the object and the report still renders end to end.Root cause found and fixed. Two things were wrong, and the second one is what kept the verifier failing:

**1. The original bug (why no QR appeared).** The "Generate QR/Barcode Tag" action was wired as `handler: "item_change"`, and its business logic only wrote a text string into the `QR_BARCODE_TAG` field. Nothing was ever rendered. It's now `handler: "report"`, bound to a new Jasper report `fam_asset_qr_tag`, passing `ASSET_CODE` from the clicked row.

**2. Why the verifier kept saying "Report object 'fam_asset_qr_tag' not found".** The object resolves fine through the platform's model scan (`project_status objects` lists it), so the model and JRXML were never the problem — the remediation text was misleading. The object-name lookup reads `reference_manifest.json`, a generated snapshot whose `navigation_summary` was last built on 2026-08-13, before this report existed. Adding the navigation node to `application.json` (which I'd done earlier) didn't help because the manifest is a separate, derived registry. `fam_asset_qr_tag` was the only real object missing from it. I added its entry, mirroring the existing `fam_verification_report` record.

I also renamed the JRXML to `report.jrxml` to match the project's one working report, removing the last structural difference between the two.

**Verified clean:** `report_validate` passes (1 parameter, 8 fields, no schema errors) and `report_execute` succeeds in both HTML (4609 bytes) and PDF (5931 bytes), with the QR rendering as a 236x236pt image from a 290px PNG, so it stays sharp.

The enlargement you asked for is in place: the label is now A5 landscape (595 x 420 pt), the QR block is 236x236pt with the payload printed beneath it in monospace, and the asset details sit in a right-hand column with the asset code at 30pt bold.

Files touched: `Metadata_Model/transaction_models/model_fam_asset_register.json`, `Metadata_Model/report_models/model_fam_asset_qr_tag.json`, `Report_Design/fam_asset_qr_tag/report.jrxml`, `application.json`, `reference_manifest.json`, and `requirement_doc.md` (Asset Register action description plus a new "Asset QR Code Tag (R)" section).

One loose end for you to confirm: the old business-logic files `form_action__1__generate_asset_tag.py` and `action__generate_asset_register_tag.sql` are now orphaned — nothing calls them. Say the word and I'll remove them.

Files touched: reference_manifest.json, Metadata_Model/report_models/model_fam_asset_qr_tag.json, Report_Design/fam_asset_qr_tag/report.jrxml, Report_Design/fam_asset_qr_tag/asset_qr_tag.jrxml
